Couple of quick technical notes to include in the matrix/narrative:
- Control-plane separation: Dedicated uses isolated control-plane VMs per customer cluster; Private (VPC-deployed) exposes a customer-managed control-plane endpoint with TLS-mutual auth + per-customer KMS keying.
- KV cache isolation: we shadow-namespace and strict token scoping; no shared in-memory KV for customer inference states.
- Egress: default egress goes through a per-cluster NAT gateway; for Private we can enable egress drop/allows and support customer-managed egress inspection via VPC peering.

I'll add a short excerpt of the routing policy (ACL summary) into the isolation_matrix_acme.csv.

-karthik

Jane — attaching the final package as discussed. Summary below and attachments included.

Executive summary (one paragraph):
Redwood separates Dedicated and Private deployments using distinct control-plane tenancy, enforced routing ACLs, and per-customer cryptographic isolation. Dedicated customers run on reserved GPU pools with segregated control-plane services; Private deployments place the runtime inside the customer's VPC while our control-plane endpoints enforce mutual TLS and KMS-bound keys. We combine prefix/KV cache isolation, per-cluster NAT egress, and automated tenant-fencing checks to provide an operational assurance model appropriate for SOC2 auditors.

Operational verification (short):
- Tenant-fencing tests: periodic chaos checks that attempt cross-tenant KV reads, automated regression tests against model-serving endpoints, and nightly ACL verification jobs. Failure triggers an incident and automated rollback of any config changes.
- Audit evidence: Isolation matrix maps each guarantee to logs/trace examples, ACL snippets, and control-plane process hashes.

Deliverables attached:
- network_narrative_v2.pdf (final narrative, one page + appendix)
- isolation_matrix_acme.csv (mapping of controls -> evidence artifacts; includes routing excerpt)
- diagram_cust_redacted.png (annotated interconnect diagram with ranges redacted)
- signed_attestation_redwood_acme.pdf (signed attestation; Legal ops stamp)

If you need anything redacted differently for procurement, tell me which elements — we can produce a redacted copy.

Regards,
